tools.name: restore_resume_version

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Edit a saved document or application using the selected operation. For document field edits read the item with detail=true for array indexes and pass an exact path (a wrong path returns the valid ones; democruit://contracts/{memberTool} lists them all), or use guided_turn to collect facts. Use fix_resume for ATS report fixes. tools.name: guided_turn
tools.description: Collect real facts, one question or one small group of questions at a time. Start with an entity, then answer using the returned draftId, revision and questionId. Supports skip, back and cancel; once canSaveNow is set, action=save stores the answers so far. Retain entity for expiry recovery. When the response lists several questions, ask them together in one step and answer once with values keyed by questionId. Operations: start | answer. Returns the response envelope; nextActions list what the user can do next, primary first.
